newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real ends off, mkt awaits mini-band drop.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real ends off, mkt awaits mini-band drop.

text.p: Brazil's real dipped 0.01 percent to close at 1.0197 to the dollar in the commercial foregin exchange market, with players awaiting a new drop in the real-dollar mini-band, dealers said.
The current mini-band, between 1.019 and 1.024 per dollar, was set on Sept 17 by the Central Bank.
"The market has been expecting a new drop in the mini-band since Thursday and it will continue to do so until the fall comes," one trader said.
In the afternoon, the real recovered some ground due to dollar inflows and the absence of interventions from the Central Bank, dealers said.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Monday surplus of $60 million.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0249 to the dollar, down 0.01 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real fell 0.1 percent to end at 1.038 per greenback.
